notes.title: [bug fix] 250811
notes.notes: Fixed a small bug where the game would softlock if some annoying guy chased you down and hit Sarah while she's in a ledge grab state.

notes.title: Update v250207
notes.notes:
A quick one! 

[*]Fixed a bug where Petunia would get stuck if it followed Sarah while she's in a ladder
[*]Fixed a bug where Petunia would bug and keep jumping if she landed on a digging spot after coming back flying
[*]Fixed a bug where quitting the game then continuing would re-equip the last used item while in the psychiatrist's office

notes.title: Update v250203
notes.notes:
Thanks once again for all the reports!

[*]Fixed a bug where getting the ice cream would still show it if you re-entered the screen
[*]Changed the screen where the elder slime's house is so you can leave it without any specific item
[*]Fixed a bug where the ghost would keep singing even after disappearing
[*]Fixed a bug where the five souls you collect would come back instantly even after delivering them
[*]Changed the way petting the dog works so Sarah's hand won't be colored along with the dog if she's painted 
[*]Changed the tilemap in one of the checkers area
[*]Removed the fish spawning from the water pit area because it's funnier
[*]Bubbleloid and Samantha now won't react differently if you're transformed in something else or invisible
[*]Added build/update number to main menu for easier tracking

notes.title: Update v250201
notes.notes:
Tons of fixes and changes since yesterday. Thanks everyone for the reports!

[*]Changed the remedy world so it's less confusing (removed one of the train entrances that wasnt working properly)
[*]Removed an invisible platform in the remedy world 
[*]Fixed a bug after the ending where it would re-load your save
[*]Changed the location of the dog in the sky planet so it's a little easier to find
[*]Fixed a bug where some NPCs would react to rats when they shouldn't 
[*]Fixed a bug where not getting the ice cream would cause it to not spawn again
[*]Fixed a tilemap issue where you couldn't fish in the water pit area
[*]Fixed a bug where using the wand on a certain NPC would not bring their feet along with them
[*]Fixed a bug where you could use the balloon item while sitting
[*]Fixed a bug where being the slime or rat and leaving the train would make you invisible
[*]Fixed a bug where the bench the train conductor sits in wasn't interactable when he wasn't sitting on it anymore
[*]Added train signs to train station entrances \
[*]Changed the last jump in the rat maze to be a little easier
[*]Fixed a bug where the currently equipped items wouldn't show in a 3D area if you came from another area
[*]Removed button name when reassigning keys
[*]Updated UFO Catch to save hi-scores

notes.title: Update v250131
notes.notes:
This update comes with:

[*]Increased volume of last 2 songs in the mp3 player 
[*]Fixed some black lines in the temple area
[*]Fixed Sarah being able to climb a certain wall in the temple area as a rat when she wasn't supposed to
[*]Fixed an npc not showing next to the vending machine after you have all the items
[*]Fixed more typos
[*]Fixed an npc showing the wrong dialogue at the bottom of the water pit

Thanks once again for the help of everyone who reported these!

notes.title: Update v250130
notes.notes:
Once again thanks to community feedback I've fixed more things and changed one thing that was asked:

v250130

[*]Fixed a bug where riding the spaceship would sometimes show you at the wrong planet
[*]Fixed a typo with one of the psychiatrist lines
[*]Changed the end part of the rat maze (no more annoying fireballs)
[*]Changed the singing timer so the song you're currently singing doesn't reset anymore (before you had to sing too quickly to finish some puzzles)
[*]Removed unintended interaction from a tree in the 3D gallery
[*]Fixed a bug in the sprite for the flowers in the forest - now it shows the right order to sing

notes.title: Update v250129
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone who reported these in the official bug thread.
Here's what fixed:

[*]Fixed a bug where the wand stars wouldn't be blocked by vines 
[*]Fixed a bug where entering a white door in the 3D gallery area would teleport Sarah out of bounds
[*]Fixed the tilemap missing tiles in the company area
[*]Fixed an invisible NPC showing up in the train when it shouldn't
[*]Fixed a bug in UFO Catch where it would keep a gaming session running even after you closed the game. Unfortunately I couldn't find a way to keep the hi-score saved, so it will reset once you close the game.
[*]Fixed a bug where Sarah would remain with gummy worm's colors after waking up

notes.title: Update v250128
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
Here's a quick patch for the bugs reported on the official bug reporting thread.

[*]Fixed a bug where teleporting from the blood area would set Sarah to the wrong Z height in the moon area.
[*]Pressing the jump button while grabbing ledges now makes Sarah go up the ledge (aside from pushing to the left/right).
[*]Fixed an unclimbable ledge in the temple area.
[*]Fixed a bug where the rock lady wouldn't show up in the 3D desert area.
[*]Fixed a typo in one of the psychiatrist's lines.

notes.title: Update v250127
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
Here's a quick patch for the bugs reported on the official bug reporting thread.

v250127 fixes:
[*]Fixed bug where the magic shop could trigger the lighter cutscene again
[*]Fixed bug where you couldn't properly select the umbrella using the analog on a gamepad
[*]Fixed a bug where using the rat hole in the art gallery would teleport you inside a building

Thanks once again to everyone who reported these!

notes.title: Update v250125
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
Here's a quick patch for the bugs reported on the official bug reporting thread.

v250125 fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed items not being properly unequiped when returning to the psychiatrist.
[*]Fixed some doors bugging out using items (usually doors that are in the same area). Also changed it so you can only enter doors by pressing "interact" button instead of the "up" button.
[*]Fixed an animation glitch for when Sarah is standing still.
[*]Fixed the magic hat not despawing when you already had it and re-entered the magic shop.
[*]Fixed the Third Eye not respecting area boundaries, and added the ability for it to loop around infinite areas.
[*]Removed a broken dialogue box when sitting in the psychiatrist's table.
[*]Fixed area boundaries in the painting world.
[*]Fixed a bug where cutting an NPC sometimes would push Sarah around if the NPC had any collision.
[*]Fixed a bug where the maze in Wishing Sarah would have bugged graphics.
[*]Fixed a bug where being a slime sometimes made it impossible to move when entering a new area.
[*]Fixed some leftover tilemaps behind ladders in the forest (which could cause you go go inside the floor).
[*]Fixed error in menu where "Use item" and "Interact" key names were swapped.
[*]Changed the way the Egg works so you de-spawn the little followers if you switch equips.
[*]Fixed bug where pictures wouldn't load properly in the gallery.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
I've just pushed an update for the demo. Here's a small list of fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed NWJS showing up as a virus on Windows
[*] Fixed a bug where coming out of ladders on the top would make Sarah keep jumping
[*] Changed the game so it uses Steam to check for your preferred language (only English and Brazilian Portuguese implemented so far!) - I think previously the game always started using PT-BR, this should fix it.
[/list]

Thanks and sorry about the virus warning. Like I mentioned in a previous comment, Awakening Sarah uses NWJS to run on Windows, which can sometimes trigger this false detection:

https://github.com/nwjs/nw.js/issues/7725

Thanks!
